mapping: causal.states_r: healthy unless warning; critical<=30, faulty<=60, degrading<=120 on rul_pred; no ratchet
caveats: R0 OOF for an inner bearing came from a model trained with the outer held-out bearing included; R0 is a fixed, untuned comparator (PROTOCOL 3.2).

rul_comparison_only.note: P1 bearing-averaged MAE (minutes); own = rows the model shows non-healthy, common = rows at/after the GT late edge; const/tso comparators fit per outer fold on D's causal onset.

coverage_descriptive.note: served symmetric band pred +/- e90 (e90 = 62.76 min, pooled OOF, nominal 90% two-sided); lower edge ~ a 5% bound, not a bearing-grouped q10
